caption: Glass on the Fold cover (#75): seven DeskClock widgets and the dock as glass surfaces over provisioning's Mauritius wallpaper, the search pill, labels under the widgets. Taken on emulator-5560 by e2e/measure-glass-frametime.sh (SCREENSHOTS=...).
The same home screen on the inner display: the fold layout's left four columns, each surface showing the backdrop region under it.

The liquid look on the Fold cover (#82): the whole home background is the blurred backdrop (wallpaperBlur), the cards are nearly clear (tint 0.12) with a directional rim and the edge lens, labels carry the app name.
The same on the inner display.

The finished glass home screen on the Fold cover (#77): analog clock, Messaging, the Vanadium search and a digital clock as glass cards labelled with their apps, the dock of real apps as Clear icons (system monochrome layers; Vanadium has none and is the desaturated fallback), the whole background the blurred Mauritius backdrop.
The same on the inner display.

The same screen with provisioning's Lawnicons installed and named in icons.pack, as a zone does (PACK=lawnicons): the dock's glyphs come from the pack as white line icons, Vanadium included - no fallback left.
The dock without a pack (top: the system apps' filled monochrome layers, Vanadium as the desaturated fallback) and with Lawnicons (bottom).
